name: Return to Troyas
summary: Daryn Lightwind sends you to Feathermoon Stronghold with her book, Feralas: A History. Troyas Moonbreeze is eager for your return.

sections.title: A Borrowed Book
sections.body: After the Super Snapper FX, Daryn Lightwind entrusts you with her book, Feralas: A History. She urges you to hurry because Troyas Moonbreeze is eager for your return. The book is bound for Troyas at Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: Troyas Reads
sections.body: Troyas Moonbreeze is glad you brought the book. He looks it over and skims its pages. Then he exclaims that he thinks he has found it.

faq.answer: You are delivering Daryn Lightwind's book, Feralas: A History.
Troyas Moonbreeze is at Feathermoon Stronghold.
Daryn Lightwind gives you the book and asks you to look after it.
The Super Snapper FX comes before this.
